ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.description: ByteInterval is a half-open raw-byte interval [start_byte, end_byte).

endByte.description: end_byte is exclusive and must be >= start_byte.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ByteInterval.json.title: Byte Interval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.description: LineInterval is a half-open one-based line interval [start_line, end_line).

endLine.description: end_line is exclusive and must be >= start_line.

startLine.description: start_line is inclusive and one-based when non-zero.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.LineInterval.json.title: Line Interval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.VerifyTracerEvide.description:
VerifyTracerEvidenceShardV1Input is the sole Stage 06 Modal operation input.
 Operation name is fixed; no clock, random, network, model, provider, database,
 or Git credential is admitted. Source bytes may be referenced by digest for
 large fixtures; inline bytes are for the bounded shard only.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins non-secret configuration for the shard.

expectedAnchorDigest.description: expected_anchor_digest is the expected canonical anchor digest.

imageDigest.description: image_digest pins the OCI image used for Modal execution.

inputBundleDigest.description: input_bundle_digest binds the full immutable input bundle.

operation.description: operation is the fixed operation name.

operationDigest.description: operation_digest pins the registered operation implementation.

operationVersion.description: operation_version pins the deterministic operation implementation version.

schemaVersion.description: schema_version echoes the manifest schema version.

shardId.description: shard_id is the fixed shard identity.

sourceArtifactDigest.description: source_artifact_digest pins the immutable source artifact bytes.

sourceByteLength.description: source_byte_length is the exact source byte count.

sourceRevisionDigest.description: source_revision_digest pins the source revision metadata.

sourceUtf8Bytes.description: source_utf8_bytes carries inline source when the shard is small enough.

spanByteInterval.description: span_byte_interval is the expected supporting-span byte interval.

spanLineInterval.description: span_line_interval is the expected supporting-span line interval.

toolchainDigest.description: toolchain_digest pins the toolchain used for both local and Modal runs.

tracerManifestDigest.description: tracer_manifest_digest binds the input to one TracerManifest.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.VerifyTracerEvide.title: Verify Tracer Evidence Shard V1 Input
